argv: async page => { const metrics = () => page.locator(".ballistic-workspace .ballistic-native-form > legend:visible").evaluateAll(nodes => nodes.map(node => { const parent=node.parentElement, card=parent.closest(".ballistic-panel"), a=node.getBoundingClientRect(), b=parent.getBoundingClientRect(), c=card.getBoundingClientRect(); return { title:node.textContent, top:a.top, ownTop:b.top, cardTop:c.top, inset:a.top-c.top, ownPadding:getComputedStyle(parent).paddingTop, float:getComputedStyle(node).cssFloat } })); const injected=await metrics(); await page.reload(); await page.getByRole("tab",{name:"可视窗口计算",exact:true}).click(); return {injected, before: await metrics()} }
